page.overview:
Who is Adrahil I?

Adrahil I was a Prince of Gondor who lived around TA 1944 in the land of Belfalas.

Adrahil was born sometime before TA 1944 and was of traceable Númenórean lineage. He served King Ondoher of Gondor as a general during the Wars of the Wainriders in the year 1944.

Adrahil was descended from a Númenórean noble house that settled in Belfalas in the Second Age. Because of this, it is assumed he was an ancestor of Imrazôr, Galador and the Princes of Dol Amroth.

When King Ondoher led his army to face the Wainriders who threatened Gondor, Adrahil commanded the army's left wing. The soldiers of the right wing were under the command of the King's nephew Minohtar, while the centre was commanded by the king himself and his heir Artamir.
